mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 600K units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence indices
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of instances when HOUST > 600K, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in accommodation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly declines in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by > 0.2pp signal improving labor market conditions, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between UNRATE and labor market confidence indices
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 35% of instances when UNRATE declines > 0.2pp for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between increasing industrial production (INDPRO) and decreasing federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a supply-side driven economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.035 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in supply-driven expansion regimes are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A spike in retail sales (RSAFS) above $380B signals increased consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, but only during the holiday season (Nov-Dec).
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between RSAFS and consumer spending during holiday seasons
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 45% of holiday season instances when RSAFS > $380B, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive quarterly declines in GDP (GDPC1) by > 0.5% signal a monetary policy-driven economic slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between GDPC1 and monetary policy decisions
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 40% of instances when GDPC1 declines > 0.5% for 2 consecutive quarters, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between increasing payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decreasing unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a labor market-driven economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in labor-driven expansion regimes are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 220 signals increased inflation expectations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during periods of high economic growth (GDPC1 > 3%).
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between CPIAUCSL and inflation expectations during high growth periods
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of high growth period instances when CPIAUCSL > 220, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 2-year rolling window.
